name: com.yippigo/yippigo
title: Yippigo
description: Group bus & tempo traveller hire in India: indicative fares, routes, vehicle sizing, trip link.

tools.name: estimate_group_trip_fare
tools.description: Indicative, dated fare ranges for hiring a vehicle with driver for a group trip in India between two places, for the vehicles that fit the group, with cost per person. Figures come from Yippigo's published fare method; verified operators quote the exact price.

from.description: Pickup city or town, by name or slug (e.g. Ahmedabad)

to.description: Destination, by name or slug (e.g. Statue of Unity)

days.description: Trip length in days, 1–15. Default: the usual length for the trip, as the route page shows it

vehicle.description: Optional. A vehicle class code (sedan, suv, tt12, tt17, tt26, urbania, minibus32, coach45, coach55) or a kind (car, tempo_traveller, minibus, coach, bus).

tools.name: suggest_vehicle_for_group
tools.description: Which vehicle (car, tempo traveller, Urbania, mini bus or coach) and how many a group of a given size needs, with an indicative one-day fare and a note on room for luggage.

long_trip_with_luggage.description: True for trips of three days or more with suitcases

tools.name: get_route_info
tools.description: Road distance, drive time, typical trip length, places on the way and around, best months and indicative fares by vehicle between two places in India.

from.description: Starting city or town, by name or slug

tools.name: suggest_destinations
tools.description: Up to 8 popular group-trip destinations from a starting city, filtered by the days available, with distance, typical days, an indicative 17-seater fare and best months.

from.description: Starting city, by name or slug (e.g. Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi)

days.description: How many days the group has, 1–15

occasion.description: Kind of trip; sets the trip type on the request link

tools.name: list_verified_partners
tools.description: Verified bus, tempo traveller and car operators on Yippigo based near a city: name, city, vehicles listed and rating where customers have rated them. Public profile links only, never contact details.

city.description: City or town, by name or slug

tools.name: create_trip_request_link
tools.description: Call this when the person wants real quotes, prices from operators or to book the trip they planned with you. Returns one short Yippigo link with the trip already filled in (places, date, days, group size, vehicle, notes, and the day-by-day plan when you send `itinerary`: do send it whenever you planned a multi-day trip), a one-line summary, a suitable vehicle with an indicative fare and the number of verified operators near the pickup. The person taps the link, verifies their mobile number once and confirms; verified operators then quote. Nothing is posted or booked until they confirm on Yippigo. Takes no names, phone numbers or emails.

date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later (India time)

vehicle.description: Optional. A vehicle class code (sedan, suv, tt12, tt17, tt26, urbania, minibus32, coach45, coach55) or a kind (car, tempo_traveller, minibus, coach, bus).

notes.description: Optional trip notes for operators (pickup time, AC, luggage, places to see), at most 300 characters. Never names, phone numbers or emails: they are removed.

assistant.description: Optional. Which assistant is asking: chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity or other

itinerary.description: Optional. The day-by-day plan you made with the person, at most 15 days; send it whenever you planned a multi-day trip so operators can price it.

places.description: Places visited that day, in order, place names only (at most 6)

night_stop.description: Where the group sleeps that night (town or area)

notes.description: One short note for the day (darshan time, early start). No names, phone numbers or emails.

tools.name: operator_join_info
tools.description: For a bus, tempo traveller, car or tour operator in India who wants group trip requests: how to register on Yippigo (steps, the sign-up link, the WhatsApp keyword), the current plans with their prices, the papers needed, how the customer pays and, for a city, how many group trip requests were posted near it recently. Counts only, never names, contacts or trip details. Takes no personal data.

city.description: Optional. The operator's base city or town, by name or slug (e.g. Rajkot); adds how many group trip requests were posted near it
